title: Image Generation
definition: The use of deep learning models (primarily Diffusion models) to generate novel visual imagery based on natural language text descriptions.
simpleExplanation: You type 'A cat riding a skateboard on Mars'. The AI starts with a screen of pure TV static, and slowly removes the static pixel-by-pixel until a perfect photorealistic image of a cat on Mars appears.

basic: Can an Image Generation AI create a picture of something that has never existed in the real world?
intermediate: What happens if two users type the exact same prompt into Midjourney? Will they get the exact same image?

answers.question: Create new things?
answers.answer: Yes. It does not 'copy and paste' from Google Images. It understands the mathematical concepts of 'Cat', 'Skateboard', and 'Mars', and chemically blends them together to synthesize a brand new arrangement of pixels.

answers.question: Same image?
answers.answer: No. The generation process starts with random mathematical noise (a random 'Seed'). Because the starting noise is different every time, the final resulting image will always be unique.
